subject: dynamic UI, conditional for initial value in popupmenu=NULL

messages.subject: dynamic UI, conditional for initial value in popupmenu=NULL
parts:
I'm building an application and I want a dynamic UI for changing the setting and structure of the widgets app using a popup menu using the library shinyBS, then I include in the UI.R  uiOuput("windows").
in SERVER.R, i can select the widgets according to menu selection. 
the popupmenu will be in "windows",so:

bsMenu("popup", type = "popup", target = "windows",
       bsMenu("plot_type3", type = "submenu", label = "display Type",
              bsMenuItem("mt_1", type = "radio", group = "dtype", value = 1", label = "Display1",checked=T),
              bsMenuItem("mt_2", type = "radio", group = "dtype", value = 1,  label = "Display2")
       )
)

if this code is in UI below of uiOuput("windows") the code doesn't create the popup menu, if I put the popupmenu code in renderUI within server.R, this code creates the popup menu:

bsMenuItemGroup("display","dtype"  ,group = TRUE)
output$windows=renderUI({list(
bsMenu("popup", type = "popup", target = "windows",
       bsMenu("plot_type3", type = "submenu", label = "display Type",
              bsMenuItem("mt_1", type = "radio", group = "dtype", value = 1", label = "Display1",checked=T),
              bsMenuItem("mt_2", type = "radio", group = "dtype", value = 1,  label = "Display2")
   
})
widgets_dis(display=menuGroups$display) # widgets_dis is a function that return a widgets list
)

but the popup menu doesn't work because the popup menu's initial value is NULL 

so i add the following conditional

if(is.null(isolate(menuGroups$display))){
widgets_dis(display="display1") # widgets_dis is a function that return a widgets list
else{
widgets_dis(display=menuGroups$display) # widgets_dis is a function that return a widgets list
}

but the popup menu doesn't work, always gets option "display1"

please, can somebody help me?
